patterns.note: High-contrast typographic pairing of an ultra-bold, wide brutalist sans-serif for brand impact with an elegant, high-contrast editorial serif for storytelling headings.
Alternating full-bleed color blocks using high-saturation signature colors (bright chartreuse/lime and royal blue) contrasted against stark black and clean white.
Asymmetric split-screen layouts where one half contains a solid color block with minimal text and the other features a high-quality, rounded-corner media asset.
An infinite horizontal marquee text banner runs continuously across the hero section, creating immediate kinetic energy upon landing.
Massive, screen-filling typographic statements ('Shape A better Future.') with mixed filled and outlined text styles acting as editorial dividers.

technique_notes: Recreate the infinite marquee using CSS keyframes animating 'transform: translate3d()' for hardware-accelerated, stutter-free horizontal scrolling.
Build the portfolio slider using Swiper.js configured with free-mode scrolling and subtle momentum to allow organic dragging of work cards.
Achieve the clean, premium card aesthetic by applying a subtle border-radius to all imagery and grid items, paired with generous, consistent grid gaps.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extreme contrast scale featuring massive, heavy display titles alongside delicate, medium-sized editorial serifs and tiny, uppercase pill-button labels.
design_tokens.radius: rounded — applied consistently to portfolio cards, team headshots, and pill-shaped navigation buttons.
design_tokens.spacing: airy — characterized by expansive vertical padding between sections and generous margins around large-scale typography.

standout: The masterful tension between raw, high-energy brutalism (the massive chartreuse hero and heavy sans-serifs) and sophisticated, high-end editorial design (the elegant serifs and spacious layouts). It makes a corporate agency feel incredibly artistic and cutting-edge.
